whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Directory.Packages.props no longer carries a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`.
